title: Head table meeting prep scratchpad
content:
Purpose: quick personal prep for the head-table / exec sync (30–40m). This is a private scratchpad — rapidly capture asks, red flags, and the three things I want people to leave remembering.

Topline narrative (15 words): Keep reliability high while we expand Dedicated capacity and finalize the Private deployment compliance checklist. Ask for decisional clarity on two items.

Meeting frame and timing:
- Arrive 5m early to confirm AV and screen share.
- Goal: align on go/no-go for Private v0.9 rollout criteria and resource commits for Dedicated Q2 ramp.
- Timebox: 12m updates, 15m decisions, 8m egress (risks + action owners).

Three key messages I want across:
1) We can deliver Private v0.9 by Apr 30 if we freeze scope to KMS + audit logging + regional networking; anything else pushes to v1.
2) Dedicated capacity ramp requires one additional infra engineer and temporary quota top-up of 4 p3s for the first month of onboard; otherwise throughput SLO risk.
3) Observability retention tradeoff: 60-day retention + sampling saves ~$60k/mo vs full retention — propose trial.

Quick situational updates (short bullets to read aloud):
- Private: compliance checklist 80% complete; legal signoff pending on data residency clause (Priya following up).
- Dedicated: load tests show 8% tail latency increase under synthetic burst; SRE investigating kernel tuning (Carlos).
- Hosted API: steady usage growth 12% MoM; cost per 1M tokens down 7% after batching tweak.

Decisions we need (clear asks to call during the meeting):
A) Scope freeze for Private v0.9? (Yes -> ship Apr 30; No -> add extra cycle)
B) Approve temporary quota + hire priority (approve finance + headcount for 1 infra contractor).
C) Approve 60-day retention trial for observability or keep current retention.

Risks & mitigations (short):
- Risk: Legal delays on residency -> Mitigation: enable regional routing but hold dataset onboarding behind manual review; contingency: deploy hosted-only customers first.
- Risk: Dedicated throughput degradation -> Mitigation: enable burst pool + rollback to older kernel, run A/B canary.

Data / metrics to bring (display on screen):
- Private readiness dashboard: % checklist done, blockers (owner + ETA).
- Dedicated perf: p50/p95/p99 under 1k/2k/6k tokens, throughput per GPU, failure rate last 7d.
- Cost delta table for retention options (current vs 60d sampling).

My ask list (who to call on):
- Priya: status of legal/data residency clause and exact remaining items (ask for ETA by EOD).
- Carlos: quick summary of burst test root cause + plan (2 slides).
- Maya: one-line recommendation for observability retention (pro/con + cost).
- Finance (Sam): approve temporary quota spend and contractor line for March–May.

Possible pushbacks and suggested responses:
- "We need full feature parity for v0.9" -> Response: we can do parity in v1; v0.9 focused on compliance and stability to unlock early customers.
- "Hiring now is tight" -> Response: propose contractor 3-month window to buy time; present cost vs outage risk.

Parking lot / nice-to-haves (do NOT block launch):
- UI polish for Private admin console (defer to v1).
- Auto-onboarding scripts for Dedicated customers (defer).

Post-meeting follow-ups (capture as actions during meeting):
- If scope freeze = YES -> Assign release manager, set milestone dates, publish customer comms draft (owner: me, due 2026-03-15).
- If quota approved -> Finance to issue PO + infra to allocate burst GPUs (owner: Sam & Carlos, due 2026-03-18).
- Legal tasks assigned -> Priya to update checklist and mark items closed (due 2026-03-16).

1:1 prep quick notes (two relevant leadership 1:1s after head-table):
- CTO (20m): ask about long-term kernel tuning roadmap and budget for profiling tools; mention hiring ask; confirm SRE priorities.
- Head of Product (20m): present v0.9 scope and timeline, confirm customer comm strategy and known early adopters list.

Personal reminders / talking style cues:
- Keep it crisp: avoid deep engineering minutiae in head-table — call out decisions needed.
- Use numbers not adjectives.
- When someone pushes back, restate the customer risk before countering.

Immediate TODOs before meeting (today):
- Pull Private readiness dashboard snapshot and attach to slide (10m).
- Ping Priya for legal ETA (2m).
- Draft 1-slide decision doc for retention trial with cost delta (15m).

Notes to self after the meeting (template):
- Record decision + who committed + due date.
- If any "tentative yes", convert to written commitment within 24h.
- Send brief summary email with action table and owners.

End-of-document quick summary (for email subject):
- Subject: Head-table: decision on Private v0.9 scope + Dedicated quota (outcome & actions)
